name: Contumacy
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. +10 ft./level)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

This spell causes followers, henchmen, hirelings, servants, and cohorts to become insubordinate and rebellious. Subjects who fail their saving throws have their attitude toward their leader shifted to hostile and they refuse to obey his commands. The leader can attempt to influence them with Diplomacy but suffers a -4 circumstance penalty to the check. As long as they remain hostile they will not obey anything he says.
